cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand up, like yours. The kettle's on strike. Help me hear its demands before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was stopping you overfilling it. I've filled it twice; it won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough water, yes. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

reason: Copied overflow warning becomes negotiation signal; B actual filling and offered inclusion shape A useful strike explanation.
